scientific_integrity: Theorem proved for the ideal cold electrostatic longitudinal three-electron-stream dispersion, with exact symbolic discriminant identities and a root-sign proof; numerical checks are supplementary, and independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Not a finite-temperature, electromagnetic, collisional, nonlinear or absolute/convective instability theorem.
Repeated real eigenfrequencies at cutoff can generate secular responses; only absence of Im omega>0 is asserted.
A 1978 exact-family primary paper is only available in abstract; scientific priority may overlap substantially.
2009-03-13 is the verified public online posting date of that 1978 source, not the original 1978 publication day. Earlier printed day-resolution public evidence was not obtained.
title: Exact spectral topology of three symmetric cold plasma streams
